intro: [!NOTE] MoviePy recently upgraded to v2.0, introducing major breaking changes. You can consult the last v1 docs here but beware that v1 is no longer maintained. For more info on how to update your code from v1 to v2,…
requirements: MoviePy can read and write all the most common audio and video formats, including GIF, and runs on Windows/Mac/Linux, with Python 3.9+.

zh.what: Python 的视频剪辑库，用代码完成剪切、拼接、变速、加字幕、混音轨、合成转场这些后期操作。生成模型出片之后，批量裁剪、加水印、拼合集基本都靠它，配合 ffmpeg 能处理绝大多数常见格式。适合需要把视频生产流水线自动化的开发者，不适合想要时间轴界面的剪辑师。

steps.title: 安装
steps.desc: 一行 pip 装上；处理视频还要系统里有 ffmpeg。

steps.title: 最小示例
steps.desc: 读入视频、截取前 5 秒、写成新文件（v2 的 API 是 subclipped）。
steps.code:
from moviepy import VideoFileClip

clip = VideoFileClip("in.mp4").subclipped(0, 5)
clip.write_videofile("out.mp4")
